content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-gpu-hosts node=host-gpu-42 region=us-west-2 metric=kubelet_notready severity=critical

pagerduty: Auto-page: On-call rotation: alice has been notified. Escalation policy: 2m -> ben -> kendra_sre.

alice: acked. digging in now. seeing kubelet NotReady on host-gpu-42 in us-west-2.

ben: i see the same in monitoring. node stopped responding to kubelet probe ~00:10 UTC. cpu and mem look normal from host exporter, but containerd shows timeouts.

kendra_sre: are pods evicting? customer impact?

alice: quick check: `kubectl get nodes | grep host-gpu-42` shows `NotReady  kubelet`

alice: listing pods scheduled there: `kubectl get pods --all-namespaces -o wide --field-selector spec.nodeName=host-gpu-42` — several tenant inference pods still Running but not responding to /live.

diego_platform: pinged the host serial console via ipmi, connecting now. serial output shows kernel oops + stack trace repeating, looks like GPU driver panic. snippet: 
```
[   73.451234] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, pid=3123, ..
[   73.451300] kernel: ------------[ cut here ]------------
[   73.451400] kernel BUG at drivers/gpu/nvidia/nvkm/...
```

ben: that matches what we've seen before with 470 driver regressions.

alice: immediate mitigation: cordon + drain to avoid scheduling new pods; then trigger failover for in-flight inference.

alice: `kubectl cordon host-gpu-42` -> `kubectl drain host-gpu-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30` (we'll force where necessary).

customer-success-liz: heads up — currently seeing elevated 503s for tenants: corpusai and searchlytics. customers alerted?

ben: corpusai has ~12% of their requests hitting us-west-2. routing policy should fallback to us-east-1 for that tenant. confirming.

kendra_sre: mark incident as potential customer-impacting. open a short status note in #incidents and ping support. liz please post customer-facing blurb.

customer-success-liz: posting now: "We're investigating degraded responses for inference in US-WEST. Engineers are actively mitigating; we'll share ETA in 15m." :writing_hand:

alice: drain started. some pods stuck terminating (CRIO stuck on SIGTERM). dropping to `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0` for impacted inference pods to allow replicas to restart in other racks. doing in batches to avoid thundering herd.

ben: routing holds: autoscaler bumped up fallback capacity in us-east-1 and us-west-1. traffic steering rules applied: tenants with healthy failover have been shifted. still ~3 tenants with sticky affinity — working on those.

diego_platform: serial console: host kernel repeatedly panics, watchdog reboots, kubelet never re-registers. hardware team advised RMA for PCIe slot + nvme; we've opened hw-ticket RHW-8421.

alice: escalated to hardware oncall. opening incident summary doc: `incident/1719123456-gpu-node-kernel-oops` and capturing timeline.

ben: tracking mitigations: cordon/drain ✅, forced pod restart ✅, traffic steering active ✅, hw RMA started.

kendra_sre: next: schedule a controlled decommission of the host, mark as unschedulable in inventory, and add an automated test for driver Xid=79 patterns. also file bug with driver vendor with logs attached.

customer-success-liz: updated customers: "Mitigation in progress; most traffic routed to healthy regions. We'll provide a full post-incident summary after root cause. For immediate concerns DM support."

alice: handing off to ben for follow-up and RCA. i'll drop out of rotation in 10m. ben, you're lead for post-incident.

ben: taking over. leaving notes in the incident doc and pinging infra for slice of similar hosts for bulk checks.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for oncall alice (handed to ben). set status=investigating -> lead=ben.

kendra_sre: thanks team. final log snippet and action items in incident doc. we'll reconvene if RMA doesn't clear the node in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
